snippet.title: Critical Shift - Announcement Trailer (2025)
snippet.description:
Critical Shift is a hardcore turn-based tactical game with RPG elements and a deep, dramatic story. You’ll face an atmospheric sci-fi mystery, filled with the unknown and the strangest of phenomena.Every enemy is a deadly threat, and resources are worth their weight in gold.
Think you can survive?
📌 Add to your wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3395320/Critical_Shift/
💬 Join our Discord server: https://discord.gg/Pn449EeQ7Y
Discuss the game, share your theories, and become part of the game's community.
